name: Beřovice (Czechia)
description: Two equal vertical stripes of blue and red; a white rose with yellow centre and a diagonal yellow arrow with white head and fletching in the blue stripe, and three white wedges pointing from the fly edge in the red stripe.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 6 January 2021 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
